sources.summary: His new series begins with Charlotte, who endured an ex-partner’s coercive control. Plus: David Attenborough goes for the double at the National Television Awards. Here’s what to watch this evening 9pm, U&W Relationship expert Paul C Brunson fronts this new series, which takes a case-by-case look at various forms of emotional, sexual and psychological manipulation. It starts with Charlotte, who recounts an affair that passed through love-bombing, suicide threats and coercive control, and eventually culminated in violence. The goal is to help others spot red flags – but it’s also a tribute to Charlotte, who appears brave and candid. Phil Harrison Continue reading...
